autoBet.heading: Auto Prediction
autoBet.intro: If you forget to submit a prediction for a match before it starts, the system will submit an automatic prediction on your behalf after kickoff.
autoBet.chooseMode: You can choose how auto prediction works on the "Match Predictions" screen:
autoBet.defaultModeText: — a 0:0 prediction is submitted. In knockout matches that require choosing a qualifier, a random qualifier is selected.
autoBet.randomModeText: — a random prediction is drawn, including the qualifier in knockout matches.

disclaimer.heading: Disclaimers
disclaimer.text: The rules are set by the tournament admin (known among your group as "{{owner}}"), and the site managers are not responsible for the prizes or the scoring method

generalRules.heading: General
generalRules.questions: If you have questions about the rules, please contact the tournament admin
generalRules.exceptional: If an exceptional case occurs that is not covered by the rules, the decision will be made at the site managers' discretion

bracket.ruleQualifiersOnly: You bet only on who qualifies (advances) in each knockout game — no score prediction.
bracket.ruleQualifierAndScore: You bet on who qualifies (advances) and what the exact score will be in each knockout game.
bracket.ruleWinnerRunnerUp: You pick a Winner and a Runner-Up — one team per side of the bracket (they are meant to come from different sides).
bracket.ruleAutoLock: The qualifier for your chosen Winner/Runner-Up teams is auto-selected and locked in every game they play.
bracket.ruleStart: The tournament starts at the first knockout kickoff; from then on your Winner/Runner-Up picks are locked.
bracket.noteBoth: If one of your pre-selected finalist teams advances in a knockout round, you earn both that round's Qualifier points and the Finalist Bonus points.
bracket.noteNotInGame: If your Winner/Runner-Up isn't in a given game, you can still earn the normal qualifier points for that game.
bracket.noteResult: If you also predict a game's exact score, you earn the Exact score points on top of any qualifier points.
bracket.noteThirdPlace: The third-place game awards qualifier points only.

sendingBets.heading: Submitting Predictions
sendingBets.matchBetsText1: Each match result prediction can be edited up until kickoff.
sendingBets.matchBetsText2: All predictions are revealed at kickoff and can be viewed in the "View Predictions" tab.
sendingBets.primalBetsText1: All special predictions and group rankings must be filled in before the opening whistle of the first match in the tournament.
sendingBets.primalBetsText2: These predictions cannot be edited or changed during the tournament.

groupStandings.heading: Group Rankings
groupStandings.perfectExplanationText: = ranking places 1-4 in the group in the exact order they finished the group stage
groupStandings.minorMistakeExplanationText: = swapping two adjacent places (one mistake between places 1,2 or 2,3 or 3,4)

teamAchievement.intro: Each stage reached earns the predictor points
teamAchievement.runnerUpNote: You cannot choose the same team as both "Runner-up" and "Winner"

topScorer.heading: Top Scorer
topScorer.description: The player who finished the tournament with the most goals
topScorer.noSwap: You cannot change your top scorer during the tournament (even if a player is injured)
topScorer.tie: In case of a tie for top scorer, any prediction on one of the players earns the predictor the {{score}} points for winning the title

mostAssists.heading: Top Assists
mostAssists.description: The player who finished the tournament with the most assists
mostAssists.noSwap: You cannot change your top assists player during the tournament (even if a player is injured)
mostAssists.tie: In case of a tie, a prediction on one of the players earns the predictor the {{score}} points for winning the title

mvp.heading: Tournament MVP
mvp.description: The player chosen as tournament MVP by FIFA (decided at the end of the tournament)

offensiveTeam.heading: Strongest Attack in the Group Stage
offensiveTeam.description: The team that scored the most goals in the group stage
offensiveTeam.tie: In case of a tie, any prediction on one of the teams earns the predictor full points
